messages.author: swarm
messages.text:
BL-1938 — A local seat's tuning report pairs each request with its own model's load - BL-1851 labels a request with the latest Ollama load of any model, so on a server that also loads another model the request can print that model's layers and KV cache as its own; pair by the request's model tag (its manifest names the blob each load line carries) and print unknown serving when no load of that model exists
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A spec gap QA raised on BL-1851 (note 003790, 2026-10-03). No choice is posed: a request is labelled only by a load of its own model, and reads unknown serving otherwise, which is BL-1851's own invariant 2 (a field no record carries prints as unknown, never a guess). FIRM: BL-1851 ships as minted, …
BL-1938 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1938" (or "reject BL-1938 <reason>") to act.
